## Scope

Describe the user-visible outcome and the files intentionally changed.

## Evidence changes

- [ ] No regulatory fact changed
- [ ] Primary source URL and pinpoint recorded
- [ ] Binding status and effective/commencement status checked
- [ ] Freshness dates updated from an actual source review
- [ ] Independent second reviewer recorded before evidence-tier promotion

## Execution review

- [ ] `python -m tools.verify` passed
- [ ] Wheel built and installed in a clean environment
- [ ] No direct push/write permission added to scheduled workflows
- [ ] Docs, manifest and MCP tool surface agree
- [ ] No secret, personal data or production decision payload committed

## Residual risk

List every incomplete review or external dependency. Do not describe a pending gate as complete.
